description: This file defines the ChartListPage class, a page object model for automating interactions with the chart list page in a web application using Playwright. It includes methods for navigation, waiting for table load, retrieving chart rows, and performing actions like delete, edit, export, and bulk operations.

classes.name: ChartListPage
classes.description: A page object model class for interacting with the chart list page, providing methods for navigation, chart row retrieval, and actions such as delete, edit, export, and bulk operations.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates to the chart list page with view mode set to table.

methods.name: waitForTableLoad
methods.description: Waits for the chart table to become visible, indicating the page has loaded.

methods.name: getChartRow
methods.description: Returns a Locator for a specific chart row by name.

methods.name: clickDeleteAction
methods.description: Clicks the delete button for a specified chart.

methods.name: clickEditAction
methods.description: Clicks the edit button for a specified chart.

methods.name: clickExportAction
methods.description: Clicks the export button for a specified chart.

methods.name: selectChartCheckbox
methods.description: Selects a chart's checkbox in bulk mode.

methods.name: clickBulkAction
methods.description: Performs a bulk action such as delete or export by action name.
